title: Modified Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Extraction Method for eDNA Extraction
author: Yoamel Milián-García
materials: Mechanically disrupt every quarter piece before Proteinase K digestion using the Qiagen TissueLyser II (1 min at 30 Hz). Extended times and higher frequencies can be explored as needed (please, consult Qiagen TissueLyser manufacturer´s instructions [https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/human-id-and-forensics/automation/tissuelyser-ii/]). Spin the samples down at 11,000 g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare filter samples
steps.instruction: Thaw a filter on a sterile Petri Dish (e.g., Fisher Scientific Catalog No. FB0875713 or FB0875713A), cut into quarters (or halves), and further cut into strips using sterile razor blades.

substeps.instruction: Use sterile forceps or 1 mL pipette tips to support filter strip manipulations.

steps.title: Initial sample setup and lysis
steps.instruction: Place small strip pieces of each quarter (or half) into independent 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes containing approximately 250 mg of glass beads (0.75–1 mm diameter).

substeps.instruction: Spin samples down at 11,000 g for 30 seconds.
Add 380 μL Buffer ATL.
Add 20 μL Proteinase K.
Mix thoroughly by vortexing for 10 seconds.
Incubate at 56°C overnight, shaking at 700 r.p.m (e.g., Ohaus Orbital Shaker, Item Number: 30391924).

steps.title: Secondary lysis and processing
steps.instruction: Process the incubated samples to further release DNA.

substeps.instruction: Vortex for 15 seconds and spin down at 11,000 g for 30 seconds.
Add 400 μL Buffer AL and mix by vortexing for 10 seconds.
Incubate at 56°C for 10 minutes, shaking at 700 r.p.m.

If using a glass fiber filter: transfer all material (lysate and filter pieces, excluding glass beads) to a QIAShredder column (Qiagen Catalog No. / ID: 79656) and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 20,000 g to recover lysate.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 400 μL ethanol (96–100%) to the sample and mix thoroughly by vortexing for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture (including residue, excluding filter pieces and glass beads) into a DNeasy Mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add the mixture in increments of up to 650 μL.
Place the column in a 2 mL collection tube (manufacturer provided or microcentrifuge tube) and centrifuge at 11,000 g for 1 min.
Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Repeat this process a second time to ensure all mixture is loaded.

steps.title: Wash DNA membrane
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes of the DNeasy Mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Place column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 μL Buffer AW1, centrifuge for 1 min at 11,000 g, and discard flow-through and tube.
Place column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 μL Buffer AW2, and centrifuge for 5 min at 17,000 g to dry the membrane.
Discard flow-through and collection tube.
If ethanol carryover occurs (column contacts flow-through), empty the collection tube and centrifuge again for 5 min at 17,000 g.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the membrane into a clean 1.5 mL tube (e.g., LoBind Eppendorf, Catalog No. 022431021).

substeps.instruction: Pipet 100 μL Buffer AE (prewarmed at 70°C) directly onto the DNeasy membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 11,000 g to elute.
Pool DNA extracts from different quarters (or halves) into a single tube.

steps.title: Optional second elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution process under the same conditions as the first elution, keeping the second elution separate from the first.
